capabilities: inject latest Lucide and Lucide Lab icons into Obsidian
provide icons usable by other plugins such as Note Toolbar
render icons with Obsidian's native 24x24 SVG formatting
disambiguation: Not an icon customizer or picker; it only supplies additional icons for Obsidian and other plugins to use.
extras: Can be installed via BRAT; explains for developers why addIcon() is not used (it forces a 100x100 viewBox). Includes a trademark disclaimer that it is not affiliated with Lucide Icons.
problem: Obsidian ships most Lucide icons but lags behind on the newest ones, so plugins and users can't use recent icons like list-clock or user-group.

relations.evidence: Inject additional mainstream icons from Lucide and Lucide Lab to Obsidian.

summary: Icon provider that injects the latest mainstream icons from Lucide and Lucide Lab into Obsidian's icon set.
